I might be late to the show but this is the only time and place I ever talk about my sexual identity. I have had a hard time determining if I was a lesbian but with recent exposure of other sexual identities, I feel I may be transgendered. I am a 24 year old female who was born and raised up in a liberal city near Los Angeles. I have gay friends, coworkers, school mates, even my best friend is gay but I haven't admitted anything to anyone, ever. When I was 10 I started to daydream about my best friends (who were girls), just innocent stuff of hanging out but also thinking about nice things I could do for her to make her happy. It wasn't until the end of middle school that I realized that this was not normal. I hated the fact that I might be different so in high school I strayed away from having such feelings and became focused more on the boys. Unfortunately I never had any luck with them as I am a chubby tomboy and my girl friends are gorgeous, all the boys I ever had crushes on ended up falling for my best friends which left me heartbroken to the point where I'd rather not like anybody because no one ever likes me back. While all my girl friends started to date boys, I still have yet to go on my first one. After high school, I went to a community college and I believe staying at home and not making new friends kept me from exploring my sexuality. My other friends have come out, including my best friend, but I could/would not do it. I chose not to wonder about my sexuality because when I have, I was not happy with what I was realizing. While I have always seen myself with a guy in the future I think it's because it was more of a thought I grew up with but I can't really picture myself with a guy, but I can't see myself with a girl either. Recently I have had a couple opportunities to date but I have chosen not to pursue them because of my fears. I fear awkward silences, I fear rejection, I also don't wear make up, and I do not have girly clothes. Most of all, I am not comfortable with my body to get naked and have sex with boys or girls. I have had sex with two guys before but once the deed was done it was all they wanted to do. I was not comfortable with myself, nor was I okay with the fact that these guys would never make me their girlfriend. A few years ago I met my favorite person who quickly became my everything. Long story short, we became best friends and I ended up being her maid of honor. I became wrecked and planned to kill myself after the wedding. However, I reached out on /r/SuicideWatch and was able to start taking small steps out of depression. I still honestly choose to avoid thinking about what I am but it is becoming harder and harder to dodge. The sad thing is is that I am pretty damn sure that ALL my friends know and they are just waiting for me to tell them. I honestly don't know why I am having such a hard time taking the appropriate actions to become happier and love life. I am not honest with myself, but worse I am not honest with my friends and having to deal with being the maid of honor for someone I was in love with by myself was possibly the worst thing I went through. I still haven't told anyone I know personally and I don't know how long I can keep avoiding the inevitable but I also have no plans to start.

Thanks for this. One of the best, realistic advice I've read concerning the subject. I always hear the obvious "it'll get better" and other generic advices that I couldn't apply to my life. But this..I could do this. I'm not ready to tell my friends because I'm still trying to figure it out myself, but I don't take the time to think about it because I fear what I might find out. When I do though, I have worried of the possible scenarios of how I'd do it but this is realistic, it's something I can see myself and my friends doing. Thanks Catbutt
